description: Takes the prospect list and writes personalized cold emails and/or LinkedIn connection requests. Signal-driven, product-specific, in the user's voice. Asks channel preference (email, LinkedIn, or both) before drafting. Batch mode for multiple prospects, single mode for one. Triggers: /outreach, "write emails", "draft outreach", "write linkedin", "draft linkedin", "outreach email", "outreach linkedin", "outreach both". Reads: ./gtm/icp.md, ./gtm/voice.md, ./gtm/company.md, ./gtm/signals.md, ./gtm/prospects.md, ./gtm/learnings.md. Writes: updates prospects.md status, appends to learnings.md. Standalone: yes — works with just a name + company.
